story.text: 다음 날, 나는 길가의 어묵 가게를 보며 또박또박 말했다. "정말 맛있어 보이는 가게네요." 하늘이 옆에서 픽 웃었다.
story.reading: da-eum nal, na-neun gil-ga-ui eo-muk ga-ge-reul bo-myeo tto-bak-tto-bak mal-haet-da. jeong-mal mas-iss-eo bo-i-neun ga-ge-ne-yo. ha-neul-i yeop-e-seo pik us-eot-da.
story.en: The next day, I looked at a fish-cake stall on the street and said, very properly, "What a delicious-looking shop." Haneul smirked beside me.

story.text: "그런 말투 누가 써. 놀랍거나 좋을 땐 그냥 '대박'이라고 해." 그가 팔짱을 끼며 정정했다.
story.reading: geu-reon mal-tu nu-ga sseo. nol-lap-geo-na jo-eul ttaen geu-nyang dae-bak-i-ra-go hae. geu-ga pal-jjang-eul kki-myeo jeong-jeong-haet-da.
story.en: "Who talks like that. When something's surprising or amazing, just say 'daebak'." He corrected me, arms crossed.

story.text: 어묵을 한 입 베어 물고 내가 "어, 대박, 맛있어요"라고 하자, 그는 짧게 답했다. "인정." 처음 들어보는 그 한마디가 왠지 웃겼다.
story.reading: eo-muk-eul han ip be-eo mul-go nae-ga eo, dae-bak, mas-iss-eo-yo-ra-go ha-ja, geu-neun jjalb-ge dap-haet-da. in-jeong. cheo-eum deul-eo-bo-neun geu han-ma-di-ga waen-ji ut-gyeot-da.
story.en: I bit into the fish cake and said, "Oh, daebak, this is good," and he answered shortly: "In-jeong." (Agreed.) Hearing that word for the first time was somehow funny.

story.text: 내가 분위기를 살려보겠다고 던진 농담이 완전히 실패했다. 정적이 흘렀다. "이게 바로 갑분싸다." 하늘이 무표정하게 평가했다.
story.reading: nae-ga bun-wi-gi-reul sal-lyeo-bo-get-da-go deon-jin nong-dam-i wan-jeon-hi sil-pae-haet-da. jeong-jeog-i heul-leot-da. i-ge ba-ro gap-bun-ssa-da. ha-neul-i mu-pyo-jeong-ha-ge pyeong-ga-haet-da.
story.en: The joke I threw out to liven things up completely fell flat. Silence hung in the air. "This, right here, is gapbunssa." (a sudden awkward mood) Haneul assessed it, deadpan.

story.text: 그러다 지나가던 강아지가 내 신발 끈을 물고 안 놔주는 소동이 벌어졌다. 둘이서 배꼽을 잡고 웃었다. "와, 이거 완전 꿀잼이다." 그가 드물게 크게 웃으며 말했다.
story.reading: geu-reo-da ji-na-ga-deon gang-a-ji-ga nae sin-bal kkeun-eul mul-go an nwa-ju-neun so-dong-i beol-eo-jyeot-da. dul-i-seo bae-kkob-eul jab-go us-eot-da. wa, i-geo wan-jeon kkul-jaem-i-da. geu-ga deu-mul-ge keu-ge us-eu-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: Then a passing dog grabbed my shoelace and wouldn't let go — total chaos. We both burst out laughing. "Wow, this is straight-up kkuljaem." (super fun) he said, laughing loudly, which was rare for him.

story.text: 신이 나서 어릴 때 이야기를 줄줄 늘어놓자, 그가 손을 들어 막았다. "됐어, 거기까지. TMI야." 하지만 듣는 표정은 싫지 않아 보였다.
story.reading: sin-i na-seo eo-ril ttae i-ya-gi-reul jul-jul neul-eo-noh-ja, geu-ga son-eul deul-eo mag-at-da. dwaess-eo, geo-gi-kka-ji. ti-em-a-i-ya. ha-ji-man deut-neun pyo-jeong-eun silh-ji anh-a bo-yeot-da.
story.en: Getting excited, I launched into a long story from when I was a kid, but he held up a hand to stop me. "Okay, that's enough. TMI." But the look on his face while listening didn't seem to mind at all.

story.text: "너도 이제 슬슬 신조어 좀 쓰네." 그가 툭 던졌다. "다 너한테 배운 거잖아." 나는 웃으며 대꾸했다. 골목을 걷는 발걸음이 가벼웠다.
story.reading: neo-do i-je seul-seul sin-jo-eo jom sseu-ne. geu-ga tuk deon-jyeot-da. da neo-han-te bae-un geo-jan-a. na-neun us-eu-myeo dae-kku-haet-da. gol-mog-eul geot-neun bal-geol-eum-i ga-byeo-wot-da.
story.en: "You're finally starting to use some slang." he tossed out. "I learned it all from you," I shot back with a laugh. Our footsteps down the alley felt light.

words.meaning: a sudden awkward/dead silence (short for '갑자기 분위기 싸해짐')
words.example_en: My joke made the mood suddenly awkward.
The movie I watched yesterday was hilariously fun.
That's way too much information, stop talking.
